---
name: Spike
about: Research or experiment to resolve uncertainty and guide subsequent work.
---

<!-- Define the uncertainty to resolve, not a solution that must be proved right.
The result may be a recommendation, a ruled-out approach or a need for further work.
Remove these guidance comments from the final issue. -->

## Context and decision to inform
<!-- Why is this investigation needed? Explain the current situation and the
decision or work its findings will inform. -->

## Questions
<!-- List the specific questions to answer. Distinguish essential questions from
optional exploration so the investigation stays focused. -->

## Starting evidence
<!-- Link relevant observations, previous attempts, code, designs or research,
with a short explanation of each. Separate confirmed facts from hypotheses and
identify missing inputs or access needed to investigate. -->

## Scope and time limit
<!-- Define what is in and out of scope, including whether a prototype is useful.
Agree on a time or effort limit before starting; record it here or say it is still
to be agreed. Include relevant constraints, such as cost or environment access.
At the limit, record progress and decide whether further investigation is worthwhile. -->

## Expected output
<!-- What finding, comparison, experiment result or recommendation will answer the
questions? Record it on this issue or in a linked document, with supporting evidence,
remaining uncertainty and recommended next steps. State what would be sufficient
to make the decision. An inconclusive result should explain why and what is needed
next; production code or a separate document is not required. -->
